sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Pelli Clarke & Partners has completed the Lola Mora Cultural Center in San Salvador de Jujuy , Argentina , a new cultural institution dedicated to the life and work of Argentine sculptor Lola Mora (1866-1936). Located in the country's northwestern region, the project is the firm's first cultural building in South America and the final project led by its founder , the late César Pelli . Designed as a net-zero facility, the center brings together six of Mora's monumental marble sculptures for the first time in more than a century, providing a permanent home for works that were previously displayed outdoors in Jujuy.
